annotation.title_clean: Blockchain Infrastructure for Intelligent Cyber–Physical–Social Systems: Post-Quantum Security, Interoperability, and Trustworthy Data Economies in the Era of Embodied AI
annotation.title_en: Blockchain Infrastructure for Intelligent Cyber–Physical–Social Systems: Post-Quantum Security, Interoperability, and Trustworthy Data Economies in the Era of Embodied AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Guo, S.; Huang, H.; Liu, D.; Zhang, A.; Zhang, L.
annotation.summary_en: Tutorial proposal for IEEE ICBC 2026 presenting blockchain as a trust and coordination layer for embodied AI and cyber-physical-social systems, covering post-quantum security migration, cross-shard interoperability, and trustworthy robotic data provenance using Croissant metadata. Technical rather than regulatory; governance appears only as open challenges.
key_provisions_or_claims: Blockchain should evolve into trust and coordination layer for embodied AI and CPSS.
Crypto-agility and hybrid migration needed against quantum threats to ECDSA signatures.
BrokerChain cross-shard protocols enable scalable interoperability.
Croissant metadata and blockchain provenance support trustworthy robotic datasets.
Open challenges: governance of cryptographic transitions, standards-aware interoperability, incentive alignment.
